brandKit.note: No brand kit, voice guide, logo file, favicon, or standards document was found in the repository or served on the live site. PURPOSE must not invent brand policy.

policy: No value in this registry is brand policy until the owner marks it approved. Missing values stay null and are marked NEEDS OWNER REVIEW. PURPOSE must ask the owner instead of inventing a value.

mission.statement.note: Owner must supply the approved mission statement.

mission.promise.note: Owner must supply the approved brand promise.

positioning.statement.note: Owner must supply approved positioning and differentiators.

audience.primary.note: Owner must define the primary audience.

audience.secondary.note: Owner must define any secondary audience.

audience.exclusions.note: Owner must state who the brand does not serve.

voice.tone.note: Owner must supply approved tone descriptors.

voice.personality.note: Owner must supply approved personality traits.

voice.weSay.note: Owner must supply approved phrasing examples.

voice.weAvoid.note: Owner must supply phrases and styles to avoid.

readingLevel.note: Owner must specify reading level or accessibility guidance.

claims.approved.note: Owner must list claims that may be repeated.

claims.banned.note: Owner must list prohibited claims, including medical, therapeutic, or guaranteed-outcome language.

disclaimers.required.value: Educational content is not a substitute for professional help.
disclaimers.required.source: Observed in the live site footer on 2026-10-26
disclaimers.required.note: Observed text only. Owner must confirm this is the required disclaimer and whether more are needed.

cta.primary.note: Owner must approve primary calls to action and their URLs.

content.pillars.note: Owner must define approved content pillars.

content.prohibitedTopics.note: Owner must define topics PURPOSE must never author.

channels.approved.note: Owner must approve which channels PURPOSE may prepare content for.

seo.canonicalHost.note: Observed host only. Owner must approve canonical policy, title patterns, and description patterns.

seo.titlePattern.note: Owner must supply approved title templates.

seo.descriptionPattern.note: Owner must supply approved meta description guidance.
